payload.text: dc's one Desk booking, from devbin-vc's Desk on rhadamanth once devbin-vc's sweep of devbin 0.1.23 has landed in Intent and vc calls it. Every step runs one after the other and none beside a kovacs run (hv decision 45). (1) Hold 41's WP-06 proof run: the v3 bank rebased onto the sweep, its arms red then green, and the bats suite at N=24 with its serial lane. (2) 0682's by-hand bin/devbin gate rust with TMPDIR on a 1.7G disk image, mounted for the run and then detached and deleted. (3) dc banks, and vc lands WP-06 with 0682's Resolution and close. (4) bin/devbin release gates --leg kovacs. (5) The dry run. Its pre-flight runs no gate, and it needs no intentd running and every seat's board committed. releasing.md step 2's commits are in: def0a8e01, bd525bae2, 7c6bfa53d and 573f817b2. The booking waits for the sweep's commit and vc's call (vc, 2026-11-12).
